title: Transport of scalar units through ordinary isomorphisms
statement: Use the abstract scalar-unit predicate of [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-scalar] for categories C,D,C',D', functors U,V,L,M and e:M⋙V≅U⋙L. Let a:F'≅F, b:G'≅G, η':F'→U(G'), η:F→U(G), with a.inv≫η'≫U(b.hom)=η. If η' satisfies IsScalarExtensionUnit L M e, so does η.

source.place: Tag 07A6, lemma-adjoint; elementary consequences of adjunction hom equivalences and naturality for the universal-property presentation.

proof.text: For every K, precomposition with M(b.hom) is a bijection Hom(MG,K)≃Hom(MG',K), with inverse precomposition with M(b.inv). Precomposition with L(a.inv) is a bijection Hom(LF',VK)≃Hom(LF,VK). Compose these bijections with the assumed scalar-unit bijection. Expand the defining function, use functoriality and naturality of e.inv at b.hom, and substitute a.inv≫η'≫U(b.hom)=η. The composite is precisely the scalar-unit map for η, so it is bijective.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A6; formal categorical API for the unchanged scalar-unit universal property, proved from Mathlib adjunction/naturality.

theorem isScalarExtensionUnit_transport
    {C D C' D' : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category C'] [Category D']
    {U : D ⥤ C} {V : D' ⥤ C'} (L : C ⥤ C') (M : D ⥤ D')
    (e : M ⋙ V ≅ U ⋙ L) {F F' : C} {G G' : D}
    (a : F' ≅ F) (b : G' ≅ G) (η' : F' ⟶ U.obj G') (η : F ⟶ U.obj G)
    (hη : a.inv ≫ η' ≫ U.map b.hom = η)
    (h : IsScalarExtensionUnit L M e η') : IsScalarExtensionUnit L M e η
